description: modules/identityaccess — POST /auth/session/validate without a refresh token, which the BFF asks on every page view (#5399). One administrative transaction (BEGIN, SET LOCAL ROLE, ..., COMMIT) reads, without row locks and without claims, the family, the account, then the session policy's facts through the definitions the refresh's guard reads under its locks (sessionPolicy.check), the MFA floor and the school the refresh keeps the session at. Facts: guardian schools (mappings, roles per school, live schools; 3). Kept at: the default school of a token without one (mappings, school; 2). The parent portal follows no MFA rule. Then the booking of Eltern-App in the portal port's own tenant transaction (4). development: 8, which checked neither guardian role nor booking.
